# Rift

> Rift is wallet and payments infrastructure for products in Africa: passkey-owned (non-custodial) smart-account wallets, gasless transactions, stablecoin payouts to mobile money, bank, till and paybill, onramp, swaps and bridges, a customer ledger, webhooks, an embeddable widget and TypeScript SDKs. Everything is one REST API. Sandbox (https://sandbox.riftfi.com) is free; production (https://api.riftfi.com) is a flat $88 per month. Fund-moving calls start on your server but are approved by the customer's passkey.

Important rules for agents integrating Rift:
- Start in the sandbox. Use a sandbox project key against https://sandbox.riftfi.com.
- Never put an `sk_` or `psk_` key in client-side code or commit it. Public `pk_` keys are being introduced for frontends; existing keys keep working.
- Never retry a fund-moving request automatically. Look up its status first.
- A server-initiated payment returns 202 APPROVAL_REQUIRED; the customer approves it with a passkey.

- [Getting started](https://riftfi.com/docs/getting-started/): environments, keys, first call, going to production
- [Authentication](https://riftfi.com/docs/authentication/): keys, tokens, headers, CORS

- [Capabilities](https://riftfi.com/docs/capabilities/): every capability group and its endpoints
- [Rate limits](https://riftfi.com/docs/rate-limits/): limits, 429 handling

## Full text for LLMs

- [llms-full.txt](https://riftfi.com/llms-full.txt): the entire documentation, self-contained: auth, every guide, error codes, webhooks, SDK, widget, and a catalogue of every endpoint with parameters and example bodies

## Reference

- [API reference — Public](https://riftfi.com/docs/api/public/): catalogue and pricing. Chains, tokens, assets, rates, rails, payout countries, and the endpoints a payer uses to settle a payment link. No session; nothing here moves money
- [API reference — Your own wallets](https://riftfi.com/docs/api/own-wallet/): for partners who hold the crypto themselves. Virtual fiat accounts to collect into and disburse from, offramp and onramp against wallets Rift never touches, plus customers, consents, webhooks, gas policy and usage. Server-side, with a psk_ platform key
- [API reference — Rift wallets](https://riftfi.com/docs/api/rift-wallet/): for partners using Rift-issued wallets, a Safe owned by the end user's passkey. Sign-in, passkeys, devices, signing, transfers, bridge, WalletConnect, offramp, onramp, beneficiaries and statements. End-user token
- [API playground](https://riftfi.com/docs/playground/): run live requests against sandbox or production with your own key; the key is kept in memory only
- [Errors and retries](https://riftfi.com/docs/guides/errors/)
- [Webhooks](https://riftfi.com/docs/guides/webhooks/)
- [Sandbox vs production](https://riftfi.com/docs/guides/sandbox-vs-production/)
- [Going-live checklist](https://riftfi.com/docs/guides/going-live/)

## SDKs and widget

- [@rift-finance/wallet](https://riftfi.com/docs/sdk/wallet/): TypeScript SDK for servers
- [@rift-finance/react](https://riftfi.com/docs/sdk/react/): React components
- [Widget (embed.js)](https://riftfi.com/docs/sdk/widget/): embed sign-in, passkey setup and approvals in any page
- [MCP server](https://riftfi.com/docs/sdk/mcp/): tools for AI agents
